name: test-watcher
description: Runs the project's tests in a thread's worktree whenever files change, shows failures and output in the side panel, flags the thread while tests fail, and sends failures to Claude.

commands.name: run
commands.title: Run Tests Now
commands.description: Run the project's test command in the thread's worktree now, replacing a run in progress.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Test Run
commands.description: Stop the test run in progress in the thread's worktree.

commands.name: set-command
commands.title: Set Test Command
commands.description: Set the command that runs the tests of the thread's project (run in the worktree with your login shell). An empty value goes back to the detected default.

args.name: command
args.description: The test command, e.g. "go test ./..." (empty: the detected default)

commands.name: send-failures
commands.title: Send Test Failures to Claude
commands.description: Send the failing tests of the thread's worktree (the latest failing run: the tests, the command and the last output lines) to Claude in the thread.

commands.name: toggle-watch
commands.title: Toggle Watching for Test Changes
commands.description: Turn running the tests on every file change on or off for the thread.
